claim_boundary: Source-only composition of one content-addressed RetroDICT profile, bundle, typed plugin descriptor, primary-source pin, and deterministic fixture. It proves neither a mounted loadout nor live RetroDICT behavior, provider/tool execution, Trace, promotion, deployment, or business uplift.

capabilities.name: compile_retrodict_loadout
capabilities.description: Validate the exact eight-mechanism default loadout and its source-safe deterministic fixture.

required: typed plugin descriptor with sidecar and direct-inline false
default profile and bundle with exact canonical mechanism order
all authority false and counters zero

output_contract.success: A source_only_unmounted loadout receipt with zero required-mechanism failures.
output_contract.failure: A typed source, plugin, profile, bundle, fixture, budget, behavior, authority, or counter blocker.
output_contract.verification: Reopen every artifact, recompute hashes, and rerun the exact deterministic fixture.

out_of_scope: provider, model, tool, simulator, or evaluator execution
Trace append, training, promotion, deployment, or fleet rollout

steps: 1. Reopen and hash the source, plugin, profile, fixture, and bundle.
2. Reject sidecar/direct-inline bypass and require exact mechanism order.
3. Require every live action to follow a logged observation and checked hypothesis with expected state.
4. Stop at the first mismatch and emit a divergence state.
6. Permit simulator/search escalation only at the finite stuck threshold.
7. Return an unmounted receipt with all authority false and counters zero.
done_definition: all eight mechanisms are present exactly once in canonical order
the deterministic fixture satisfies history, expectation, mismatch, resume, escalation, and containment rules
no operational authority or execution is inferred
repair_on_failure: repair the source artifact or mechanism fixture and freeze a new immutable successor
do not bypass the typed plugin boundary or treat source presence as runtime behavior

exec_block_rules.when: any mount, sidecar, direct-inline, provider/tool action, or authority is requested
